topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: The rain's been sluicing down all day, like the city's trying to wash itself clean. Doesn't work, of course. Got a call from this artist, says someone's been copying her work, only they're not just using paper or canvas. They’re doing it on skin. Tattoos all over the city. She says it’s ruining her, that she’s losing her edge, her style, it’s all getting watered down. People are starting to think the tattoos are her latest move, her new thing. I don’t know what I’m gonna tell her. Maybe the truth ain’t gonna help her much.
